title: F1 fixture manifest
description: Structural schema for fixtures/f1/instances.yaml. See specs/001-connect-and-browse/contracts/fixture-format.md for the authoritative contract text and the additional semantic rules (label-prefix coverage, no real-looking identifiers, empty/non-empty history coverage, CS-22 scannable prefixes) that tools/fixtures/manifest.py enforces beyond this schema.

label_prefix.description: Prefix every seeded message text must start with. Must be a bracketed marker, never empty.

device_name_prefix.description: CS-22 scannable prefix (contracts/fixture-format.md rule 7). Every P2 device name a fixture or test client sends must start with this exact, fixed value. tools/ci/scan_logs.py (T033) greps logs for it.

operator_label_prefix.description: CS-22 scannable prefix (contracts/fixture-format.md rule 7). Every `pair confirm` operator label a fixture or test client uses must start with this exact, fixed value. tools/ci/scan_logs.py (T033) greps logs for it.

continuity_evidence.description: Must always be literally false. Fixtures are never continuity evidence (owner amendment 3); tools refuse to run if this is changed.

instances.description: Fixture-local Hermes instances. F1 fixtures use exactly the keys A and B.

conversations.description: Named conversation fixtures referenced from profiles and mutations.

mutations.description: Named mutations applied by tools/fixtures/mutate.py during refresh/reconciliation tests.

key.description: Fixture-local instance key, never a real iid.

port.description: 0 means pick a free loopback port at run time. Fixtures never bake in a real port.

key.description: Fixture-local user key. The real HMP user id (hmpu_...) is minted at build time, never stored here.

name.description: Hermes profile name. Always prefixed f1- to keep it identifiable as fixture data.

authorize_for.description: User keys (from this instance's users list) authorized for this profile's bot. Empty means not authorized (pending_operator case).

conversation.description: Key into top-level conversations, or null/absent for the empty-history case.

other_sessions.description: Amendment A1 (session browsing, OD-F9/OD-F10): non-HMP sessions of this same bot, from other Hermes sources (cli, desktop, cron, ...), independent of the HMP chat/authorize_for steps above -- OD-F10 gates them by bot-level authorization only, never a per-session grant.

session_id.description: Fixture-local session key, made globally unique by the builder (instance + profile + this key). Never a real Hermes session id.

source.description: The Hermes `sessions.source` label this fixture session is seeded under (e.g. cli, desktop, cron). Never `hmp` -- that is the phone's own conversation, seeded through the normal chat/conversation path above.

conversation.description: Key into top-level conversations, for this session's seeded messages. Omit for a session with no messages (e.g. an archived placeholder).

parent_session_id.description: Another other_session's session_id, in the SAME profile, to build a compression lineage: the parent must also set end_reason: compression.

end_reason.description: Set on the ROOT of a compression lineage (end_reason: compression); its tip is the other_session entry whose parent_session_id names this one.

conversation.description: Exactly one of generate (synthesized at build time) or messages (given verbatim).
